children: Universal Health Realty Income Trust reported third-quarter 2026 net income of $4.9 million, or $0.35 per diluted share, compared with $4.0 million, or $0.29 per diluted share, a year earlier. For the first nine months of 2026, net income was $15.9 million, including a land-sale gain, and adjusted net income was $15.1 million, or $1.09 per diluted share. Nine-month funds from operations rose to $37.1 million, or $2.67 per diluted share.
Third-quarter revenue was $25.3 million, compared with $25.3 million in the same period of 2025. Nine-month revenue was $74.9 million, versus $74.7 million.
Third-quarter net income was $4.9 million, or $0.35 per diluted share, up from $4.0 million, or $0.29 per diluted share, in 2025.

Nine-month net income was $15.9 million, or $1.14 per diluted share. Excluding a $724,000 gain on land sale, adjusted net income was $15.1 million, or $1.09 per diluted share, compared with $13.3 million, or $0.96 per diluted share, in 2025.

Third-quarter funds from operations (FFO) was $12.3 million, or $0.88 per diluted share, compared with $12.2 million, or $0.88 per diluted share, a year earlier. Nine-month FFO increased to $37.1 million, or $2.67 per diluted share, from $35.9 million, or $2.59 per diluted share.
The Trust declared and paid a third-quarter dividend of $0.75 per share on September 30, 2026.
In October 2026, the Trust sold one of its two remaining Chicago-area land parcels. The parcel represented approximately 42% of the remaining acreage owned at September 30.
Construction of the 80,000-square-foot Miller Medical Plaza in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, began in February 2026 and is expected to be completed in December 2026.
A UHS subsidiary has signed a 10-year master flex lease covering approximately 75% of the Miller Medical Plaza’s rentable area, subject to reductions as third-party leases are executed.
The Trust reported investments or commitments in 77 properties across 21 states.
